Title: Outrageously Large Neural Networks: The Sparsely-Gated Mixture-of-Experts Layer
Abstract: The sparsely-gated mixture-of-experts layer enables training neural networks with over 100 billion parameters by routing each input to a small subset of experts, achieving computational efficiency at massive scale...

Title: A Survey on Mixture of Experts
Abstract: We provide a comprehensive survey of mixture-of-experts models, covering routing algorithms, expert architectures, training strategies, and applications across vision and language tasks...

Title: Toward Efficient Inference for Mixture of Experts
Abstract: We analyze the inference bottleneck in MoE models and propose dynamic gating with variable capacities to reduce latency while maintaining accuracy...

Title: Adaptive Gating in Mixture-of-Experts Language Models
Abstract: We introduce adaptive gating that dynamically adjusts the number of activated experts per token based on input complexity, trading off computation and performance...

Title: Mixture of Experts with Expert Choice Routing
Abstract: Expert Choice routing selects the top-k tokens for each expert rather than top-k experts per token, improving load balancing and training stability in MoE models...

Title: Switch Transformers: Scaling to Trillion Parameter Models with Simple and Efficient Sparsity
Abstract: Switch Transformers simplify MoE routing to a single expert per token, enabling efficient training of models with over 1 trillion parameters...

Title: ST-MoE: Designing Stable and Transferable Sparse Expert Models
Abstract: We design stable and transferable sparse expert models with improved routing stability and cross-task transferability for large-scale language understanding...

Title: BASE Layers: Simplifying Training of Large Sparse Models
Abstract: BASE layers replace top-k routing with balanced assignment, ensuring all experts receive similar numbers of tokens for stable large-scale training...

Title: Tutel: Adaptive Mixture-of-Experts at Scale
Abstract: Tutel provides an adaptive MoE system that dynamically optimizes parallelism strategies and scheduling for efficient distributed training of sparse models...

Title: MegaBlocks: Efficient Sparse Training with Mixture-of-Experts
Abstract: MegaBlocks introduces efficient GPU kernels for MoE training, achieving high hardware utilization through optimized sparse matrix operations...

Title: Pre-gated MoE: An Algorithm-System Co-design for Fast MoE Inference
Abstract: We propose pre-gated MoE with algorithm-system co-design, predicting expert activation to overlap communication with computation and reduce inference latency...

Title: Fast MoE: A Fast Mixture-of-Expert Training System
Abstract: Fast MoE optimizes distributed training of MoE models through expert parallelism and hierarchical all-to-all communication...

Title: QMoE: Practical Sub-1-Bit Compression of Trillion-Parameter Models
Abstract: QMoE achieves sub-1-bit compression of MoE models through extreme quantization, reducing storage requirements for trillion-parameter models to practical levels...

Title: MoEfication: Transformer Feed-forward Layers Are Hidden Mixture-of-Experts
Abstract: MoEfication discovers that standard transformer FFN layers can be decomposed into implicit mixtures of experts, enabling efficient conversion to explicit MoE architectures...

Title: DeepSpeed-MoE: Advancing Mixture-of-Experts Inference and Training
Abstract: DeepSpeed-MoE enables efficient training and inference of trillion-parameter MoE models through optimized parallelism and communication primitives...
